reviews.evidence: Ships curated Markdown memory rules, doctor/init tools, bounded-index guards, reader adapters, continuity sync, uninstall safety, and detailed host-specific limits.
reviews.concern: Experimental and mostly model-enforced; single-writer, personal-scale, unencrypted, and some hosts lack a hard guard.

reviews.evidence: Natural-language SQL analysis, schema exploration, dashboards, offline HTML reports, data governance, many databases, prompts, screenshots, and follow-up flows.
reviews.concern: Safety is strongly asserted, but the README gives no test evidence and little failure or compatibility troubleshooting.

reviews.evidence: Complete coding-agent TUI with anchored edits, sessions, headless JSONL, skills, hooks, lazy MCP, subagents, permission modes, commands, screenshots, and metrics.
reviews.concern: Explicit use cases are sparse; first start may automatically download search binaries.

reviews.evidence: Discovers topic-tagged public repos, filters candidates, compares matches, detects install shape, audits risky behavior, asks consent, then installs and verifies.
reviews.concern: Thin README: no sample report, verification result, troubleshooting, tests, or failure behavior.

reviews.evidence: Bundles novel and short-drama skills/roles, five-stage Markdown artifacts, three-pane editing, file following/navigation, previews, safe saves, commands, and two GIF demos.
reviews.concern: Few operating steps; reliability evidence centers on pinning and migration guidance, not tests or recovery.

reviews.evidence: Broad Pi ABI bridge with models, tools, sessions, UI, OAuth, MCP and subagents; includes walkthroughs, runnable examples, matrices, limits, probes, E2E claims, and tests.
reviews.concern: Four surfaces remain unavailable and custom cards lose styling; package confidence varies by validation level.

reviews.evidence: Aggregates three anime sources into cards, pagination, episode/group details, magnets/torrents, streaming, updates, prompts, screenshots, tests, limits, and troubleshooting.
reviews.concern: Streaming depends on user rules and third parties; dynamic rules are unsupported and Bangumi reviews use a private API.

reviews.evidence: Ready DSH distribution with GUI/TUI shared sessions, editable presets, files/Git/terminal/browser/diffs, multiple model routes, host supervision, doctor commands, and screenshots.
reviews.concern: Developer preview with mutable upstream compatibility, differing platforms/toolchains, and strict version matching.

reviews.evidence: Creates, edits, imports, verifies, reviews and exports Sheets, Docs, Slides, Bases and Boards; rich examples, video/screenshots, isolated drafts, linting, limits, and tests.
reviews.concern: Some slide checks need Chrome; slide masters/notes, advanced Board features, and Board file export are unsupported.

reviews.evidence: Multi-style web notes with images, categories, persistence/sync, Markdown/HTML/PNG exports, resource bundles, publishing, AI polish, user isolation, DSH/agent hooks, and demos.
reviews.concern: README mixes service and agent integrations; tests, compatibility, failures, and troubleshooting are sparse.
